title: PRO192 SP26 – Đề 7
description: 50 câu PRO192. Đáp án đã cross-check độc lập. Câu 43 là đề lỗi (ghi chú trong explain).

questions.q: To run a Java program, which software must be installed?
questions.explain: JRE chứa JVM + thư viện runtime — môi trường tối thiểu để chạy. JDK cũng chạy được (vì chứa JRE), nhưng câu hỏi 'must be installed' nhắm JRE.

questions.q: In binary numbers, how many digits does a byte hold?
questions.explain: 1 byte = 8 bit. Nibble = 4 bit, word thường 16/32/64 bit tùy kiến trúc.

questions.q: Which of the following best describes object-oriented programming?
options: Using classes to encapsulate data and behavior
questions.explain: OOP tổ chức chương trình quanh class/object: đóng gói dữ liệu + hành vi, hỗ trợ kế thừa, đa hình, trừu tượng.

questions.q: What is the role of the Java Development Kit (JDK) in Java programming? Choose multiple correct answers.
options: A cross-platformed software development environment that offers a collection of tools and libraries necessary for developing Java-based software applications.
A core package used in Java programming, along with the JVM and the JRE to develop and deploy applications
A software for building applications that combines common developer tools into a single graphical user interface (GUI).
A text editor that can assist in writing software code with features such as syntax highlighting with visual cues
questions.explain: JDK là bộ công cụ phát triển đa nền tảng, bao gồm JRE và JVM. C mô tả IDE; D mô tả editor — không phải JDK.

questions.q: Which is a valid keyword in Java?
questions.explain: `interface` là keyword. `include` thuộc C/C++; `Float`, `Integer` là tên class wrapper, không phải keyword.

questions.q: A Java source code will be compiled to the file in which of the following extensions?
questions.explain: `javac` biên dịch `.java` → bytecode `.class` cho JVM.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a Java feature?
questions.explain: Java không có con trỏ tường minh (khác C/C++) — đây là điểm bảo mật. Các mục B/C/D là đặc điểm của Java.

questions.q: When naming a variable in Java with multiple words, which convention should you follow?
options: Capitalize each word in the compound after the first
Start each word with a lowercase letter
questions.explain: Java dùng camelCase: chữ đầu thường, chữ sau viết hoa đầu. Ví dụ `studentName`, `totalAmount`.

questions.q: What is the primary difference between using == and .equals() for object comparison in Java?
options: .equals() checks if two references point to the same object, == determines whether two object references are identical.
== checks if two references point to the same object, .equals() determines whether two object references are identical.
.equals() is used only with wrapper classes.
questions.explain: `==` so sánh reference (cùng object không); `.equals()` so nội dung theo cách class triển khai (mặc định của Object cũng là reference, nhưng String/Integer... override).

questions.q: Which statement about loop counting variables in a for loop is FALSE?
options: They are initialized before the first iteration.
They are updated after each loop iteration.
They control when the loop stops executing.
questions.explain: Biến đếm có thể tăng/giảm tùy ý (`i += 2`, `i--`). Các mục B/C/D mô tả đúng vai trò của biến đếm.
Điều kiện `true` → ternary trả `100`, gán vào `result`, in `100`. Kiểu int khớp với giá trị nên không lỗi.
for-each gán giá trị vào biến local `i`, không thay đổi mảng. `a[1]` giữ default 0.

questions.q: Which string method is used to split a string using a regular expression?
questions.explain: `String.split(regex)` tách chuỗi theo regex. `StringTokenizer` là class khác, không có `tokenize()` trên String.

questions.q: Which of the following is one of the exception types in Java?
questions.explain: `RuntimeException` là class chuẩn trong `java.lang`. CompileException/SyntaxException/LogicException không có trong JDK.

questions.q: What is the purpose of Java's wrapper classes?
options: To encapsulate primitive types in objects.
questions.explain: Wrapper (Integer, Double, Character...) bọc primitive thành object — cần cho Collection, generic, reflection.

questions.q: What are components of a class in Java OOP? Choose multiple correct answers.
options: Constructors are responsible for object creation
Attributes, Fields, Properties of a class represented by variables
Behaviours, Modification code represented by methods or functions
main() method for execution of the class
questions.explain: Class gồm constructor, field (thuộc tính), method (hành vi). `main()` chỉ cần khi muốn chạy trực tiếp, không phải thành phần bắt buộc của class.

questions.q: In Java, if a class does not explicitly define a constructor, what type of constructor is automatically provided?
questions.explain: Java tự sinh constructor mặc định không tham số (no-arg) nếu class không khai báo constructor nào.

questions.q: Which access modifier is commonly used for setter methods in Java?
questions.explain: Setter thường `public` để bên ngoài gọi cập nhật thuộc tính (bản thân field thường `private`).
`9` và `1000000000` đều là int literal → phép nhân thực hiện trong int → overflow thành int. Overload chọn `test(int)` → in "int a".

questions.q: Which of the following is the MOST RESTRICTIVE access level for a class member in Java?
questions.explain: Thứ tự hạn chế tăng dần: private < default < protected < public. `private` chỉ truy cập trong cùng class.

questions.q: Which keyword is used to declare inheritance between two classes in Java?
questions.explain: `class B extends A` khai báo kế thừa. `implements` dùng cho interface; `super` gọi constructor/method lớp cha.

questions.q: Which field access modifier allows direct access by a subclass?
questions.explain: `protected` cho subclass truy cập (kể cả khác package, qua thừa kế). `static` không phải access modifier.

questions.q: What is the main advantage of using interfaces in Java regarding inheritance?
options: Provides faster execution speed compared to abstract classes.
Automatically generate constructor methods for implementing classes.
Allow direct instantiation of interface objects without implementing classes.
questions.explain: Java đơn kế thừa class nhưng đa kế thừa interface → đạt được 'multiple inheritance of type'.
`Dog` implements `Animal` nhưng thiếu `move()` → class không phải abstract và không implement đủ → compile error.

questions.q: Choose multiple correct answers.
options: The purpose of a getter method in Java is to get the value of a variable
The purpose of a setter method in Java is to set the value of a variable
return keyword is used to define getter and setter method in Java
Access modifier often used for getter or setter method is public
questions.explain: A/B mô tả đúng vai trò getter/setter. D đúng — thường `public`. C sai — `return` chỉ trả giá trị, không 'define' getter/setter.

questions.q: What is a way to group related classes in Java and it is called a namespace?
questions.explain: `package` nhóm các class liên quan, hoạt động như namespace tránh xung đột tên.
Constructor chạy từ gốc xuống: A → B → C. Output thực tế là `ABC` (không dấu phẩy) — A đúng về thứ tự.
Gọi `DemoClassChild.m()` trực tiếp → static method của class con → in `B`. Static không bị override (chỉ hiding).

questions.q: Choose the incorrect statement about the class.
options: A class can be extended to more than one class.
An interface can be extended with many interfaces.
A class can be extended to one class and implemented in many interfaces
questions.explain: Java đơn kế thừa: class chỉ extends 1 class. Interface có thể extends nhiều interface; class implements nhiều interface.

questions.q: Consider an abstract class "Shape" with an abstract method "calculateArea()". If a concrete subclass "Circle" extends "Shape" and provides an implementation for "calculateArea()", what happens when an object of the "Circle" class is created and the "calculateArea()" method is called?
options: The abstract method in the superclass is executed.
The concrete method in the subclass is executed.
An exception is thrown at runtime.
Both the abstract method in the superclass and the concrete method in the subclass are executed.
The result depends on whether the "calculateArea()" method is declared as static.
questions.explain: Đa hình động: object `Circle` → JVM gọi method override trong `Circle`. Abstract method không có thân để chạy.

questions.q: Choose multiple correct answers.
options: Inheritance allows a class to inherit the properties and methods of another class
The keyword "extends" is used to indicate inheritance in Java. It is used in the declaration of a subclass to specify the superclass that it is inheriting from.
A subclass can access the private members of the superclass
Java supports both multiple inheritance of classes and interfaces
questions.explain: A/B đúng về kế thừa và từ khóa extends. C sai (private không truy cập được). D sai (Java không đa kế thừa class).

options: The default static final double SPEED declaration is incorrect.
The default void run() method is invalid because interfaces cannot include method implementations.
The default void run() method is invalid because it's declared with the default keyword.
The void stop(); method is incorrect because it lacks the default keyword.
questions.explain: Field trong interface đã mặc định `public static final`; thêm `default` vào field là sai cú pháp. Method `default void run()` hợp lệ từ Java 8. `void stop()` là abstract method hợp lệ.

questions.q:
Given the following code snippet:
`int[] arr = new int[100];`
Which of the following statements is correct?
options: The maximum number of elements of the arr is 100
The maximum index of the arr is 100
Each element in the arr will be 1 by default
questions.explain: Mảng có 100 phần tử, index 0..99. `arr[100]` out-of-bounds; default int là 0.

questions.q: Choose the correct statement related to the encapsulation concept in Java.
questions.explain: Encapsulation = che giấu dữ liệu (data hiding) qua access modifier, chỉ lộ API công khai.

questions.q: In a banking application, you need to represent customer accounts using object arrays. Which OOP concept allows you to create a blueprint for the Account class?
questions.explain: Abstraction tập trung vào 'bản thiết kế' (blueprint) — định nghĩa cấu trúc/hành vi chung mà không cần chi tiết triển khai.

questions.q: Which of the following statements is used to get the size of a one-dimensional array in Java? Assume: int[] arr = new int[100];
questions.explain: Mảng có field `length` (không ngoặc). Collection mới có `size()`.

questions.q: Which of the following classes is used for shuffling an ArrayList in Java?
questions.explain: `Collections.shuffle(List)` xáo trộn ngẫu nhiên. `Arrays` dùng cho mảng, không shuffle list.

questions.q: All abstract data structures: List, Set, Map are implemented in which of the following types?
questions.explain: List, Set, Map đều là interface trong `java.util`. Các class cụ thể (ArrayList, HashSet, HashMap...) implements chúng.

questions.q: Which of the following represents a valid declaration of a List collection of integers in Java?
questions.explain: Generic phải dùng wrapper `Integer` (không phải `int`); interface không thể `new`. Chỉ A đúng cú pháp.

questions.q: Which of the following Set implementations maintains insertion order in Java?
questions.explain: `LinkedHashSet` giữ thứ tự chèn. HashSet không đảm bảo; TreeSet sắp xếp theo natural/comparator.

questions.q: What must be implemented when storing custom objects in a TreeSet to ensure proper ordering?
options: The compareTo() method from the Comparable interface.
The equals() and hashCode() methods must be overridden to maintain consistent ordering behavior.
A custom sorting algorithm that handles the specific data types and their natural ordering requirements.
The toString() method must return values that can be compared lexicographically for automatic sorting.
questions.explain: TreeSet sắp xếp qua `Comparable.compareTo()` (hoặc truyền `Comparator`). Không có thì ném `ClassCastException`.
TreeMap sắp theo key. `headMap(3)` lấy key < 3 → {1=A, 2=B} → in `AB`.

questions.q: Choose correct answer about anonymous class?
options: A class that is defined without a name and can be instantiated only once
The purpose of using an anonymous class is to provide a way to implement an interface or extend a class without explicitly defining a named class.
An anonymous class is created using the "new" keyword followed by the name of the interface or class being implemented or extended.
Anonymous classes are like local classes except that they do not have a name.
questions.explain: ⚠️ ĐỀ LỖI: A sai ('instantiated only once' — thực ra expression chỉ tạo 1 instance, nhưng bản thân anonymous class có thể tái sử dụng trong vòng lặp). B, C, D đều đúng mô tả. E không đúng vì A sai. B là lựa chọn an toàn nhất.

questions.q: How does the try-catch-finally statement work?
options: The code inside the try block is executed, and if an exception occurs, it is caught and handled by the catch block. The code inside the finally block is executed regardless of whether an exception occurred or not.

The code inside the try block is executed, and if an exception occurs, it is caught and handled by the finally block. The code inside the catch block is executed regardless of whether an exception occurred or not.
The code inside the try block is executed, and if an exception occurs, it is caught and handled by the catch block. The code inside the finally block is executed only if an exception occurred.

The code inside the try block is executed, and if an exception occurs, it is caught and handled by the catch block. The code inside the finally block is executed only if an exception occurred and was not caught by the catch block.
questions.explain: `try` chạy code; nếu exception → `catch` xử lý; `finally` LUÔN chạy dù có exception hay không (kể cả return).

questions.q: Which of the following methods of File class is used to check a file is hidden?
questions.explain: `File.isHidden()` trả true nếu file/thư mục bị ẩn theo convention hệ điều hành.

questions.q: Which of the following objects is a parameter of the constructor of the DataInputStream class?
options: An object of the FileInputStream class
An object of the File class
An object of the BufferedReader class
An object of the RandomAccessFile class
questions.explain: `DataInputStream(InputStream in)` cần InputStream. `FileInputStream` là subclass của `InputStream` nên hợp lệ.

questions.q: Which of the following methods of File class is used to check a file already exists?
questions.explain: `File.exists()` trả true nếu file/thư mục tồn tại. Các method khác không có trong API.

questions.q: How do you check if a File object refers to a file (NOT a directory) in Java?
questions.explain: `File.isFile()` trả true nếu là file thường (không phải thư mục, không phải special file).
Bytes 65,66,67 = 'A','B','C'. Ghi tuần tự, seek về 0, đọc lại đúng thứ tự → "ABC".

questions.q: What type of relationship does aggregation describe in object-oriented design?
options: "is a kind of" relationship, indicating inheritance.
"uses" relationship, where one class calls another
"has a" relationship, showing ownership or containment.
questions.explain: Aggregation = "has-a" (chứa/sở hữu). Inheritance = "is-a"; dependency = "uses".
